items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Charlie Christian was just walking through that thing just like that. But that guy, name is that walked through Georgia -- Sherman. >> [INTERVIEWER] Colonel Sherman -- or General, yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Man, he could play.

ctx.x: Charlie Christian was just walking through that thing just like that. But that guy, name is that walked through Georgia -- Sherman.

Man, he could play. And he had a lot of soul solos, and Benny knew it, and Benny let him play, you know. That's one thing. If you could play, you could do something, he'd let you do it. But Charlie was perfect. He was steady, steady, and he'd play the chords. He could play chords, man. And you didn't have to write anything for him. He would just use that seventh sense that he had, that musical sense. It would work out just fine.
